title: 1-2-3, she, the birthday party
summary: elle = she: elle doit, elle veut. Counting un, deux, trois reviews the main sound patterns. You learn à la fête (to the party), la fête d'anniversaire (birthday party), and that English -ary words often become -aire: nécessaire, contraire, extraordinaire.
points: un, deux, trois = 1, 2, 3. un = nasal un, deux = eu sound with a silent x, trois = oi ('wa').
elle (she) sounds like 'el'. A vowel followed by a consonant in the same syllable changes its sound.
elle doit / elle veut = she must / she wants. The t is silent.
Elle la veut = she wants it (fem.) or she wants her.
à la fête = to the party. de + anniversaire → d'anniversaire.
Think in syllables and letter combinations, not single letters.
drills: She wants to invite her to the party.
Elle veut l'inviter à la fête.
She wants to invite me to the party.
Elle veut m'inviter à la fête.
Does she want to invite me to the party?
Elle veut m'inviter à la fête ?
She wants to invite him to the birthday party.
Elle veut l'inviter à la fête d'anniversaire.
